content: पूरः [पूर्-क] .²1 Filling, making full; तमहमुपसृतानां कामपूरं नतोऽस्मि <ls>Bhāg. 8. 13. 47</ls>. .²2 Satisfying, pleasing, making content. .²3 Pouring in, supplying; अतैलपूराः सुरतप्रदीपाः <ls>Ku. 1. 10</ls>. .²4 The swelling or rising of a river or of the sea, flood; महोदधेः पूर इवेन्दुदर्शनात् <ls>R. 3. 17</ls>. .²5 A stream or flood in general; अम्बु˚, बाष्प˚, शोणित˚ <ab>&c.</ab> .²6 A piece of water, lake, pond. .²7 The healing or cleansing of wounds. .²8 A kind of cake. .²9 Drawing in breath slowly through the nose; प्राणापानौ संनिरुन्ध्यात् पूरकुम्भकरेचकैः .²10 The citron tree. .{@-रम्@} A kind of incense.
